notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jaxis.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the copy, adding {R}.
The creature dies, triggering itself and Jaxis.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Jaxis trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
